description: Certificate of lawfulness for proposed external wall remediation works including like-for-like replacement of combustible insulated render with non-combustible EPS Render System and brickwork removal to facilitate new sheathing board and cavity barrier installation, maintaining the existing appearance. No changes to access, layout, scale, or building footprint are proposed. Overall wall build up thicknesses to remain as existing.
decision_conditions: The proposed works come within the definition of 'operations that do not involve development' under Part (2)(ii) of Section 55 of Town and Country Planning Act 1990, thereby not requiring planning permission.

This certificate provides confirmation that the development is lawful.  You should also check whether the development requires separate Building Regulation consent. Information is available on the Building Control webpages and the team is available between 9am and 10am Monday to Friday via 01708 432700.
site_name: Priory Court & Chapel Court, Wideford Drive
